phase_title: Phase 16 実測入力受領・検証層完了宣言

governance.hard_stop_condition: This phase is design-only completion declaration only. No implementation changes of any kind are permitted.

deliverables.name: Receipt Design (Phase 16-1)
deliverables.description: 3 receipt channel options (direct API, batch upload, scheduled pull)

deliverables.name: Completeness, Signature, Consistency Validation (Phase 16-2)
deliverables.description: Required fields, signature verification, logical coherence validation

deliverables.name: Pre-Decision Update Feasibility (Phase 16-3)
deliverables.description: 6 blocking conditions, 7 readiness conditions, overall feasibility assessment

deliverables.name: Format Validation Rules (Phase 16-4)
deliverables.description: JSON structure, field type, enum, timestamp bounds validation

deliverables.name: Evidence Lock and Tamper Prevention (Phase 16-5)
deliverables.description: Cryptographic hashing (SHA-256+), timestamp mechanisms, audit trails, tamper detection

deliverables.name: Validation Failure Handling (Phase 16-6)
deliverables.description: Returnable failure procedures (data correction), non-returnable failure procedures (escalation), NO_GO state maintenance

deliverables.name: Validation Result Report (Phase 16-7)
deliverables.description: Aggregated validation outcomes from all 5 validation layers (format, completeness, signature, consistency, integrity)

deliverables.name: Workflow Execution Feasibility Judgment (Phase 16-8)
deliverables.description: 5-gate evaluation for Phase 15-7/15-8 measurement workflow execution (validation gate, action gate, pre-decision gate, NO_GO state gate, blocker clearance gate)

deliverables.name: Consistent Governance Structure (All Phases)
deliverables.description: 10 blocked actions, operation_mode=OBSERVE, execution=dry_run, production_status=NO_GO across all 8 design files

deliverables.name: app/tests Blocking (All Phases)
deliverables.description: app_implementation_status=NO_GO, tests_implementation_status=NO_GO with zero implementation changes

scope_included_in_phase_16: Design of receipt mechanisms (not actual receipt)
Design of validation rules and procedures (not actual validation)

Design of feasibility judgment gates (not actual gate evaluation)
Governance and safety structure (blocked_actions, operation_mode, NO_GO maintenance)
scope_explicitly_excluded_from_phase_16: Actual receipt of real measurement input data
Actual evaluation of feasibility judgment gates
Any state changes to integrated_decision or receiver_validator_permission
phase_16_design_scope_boundary.phase_16_is_design_only: Phase 16 is 100% design-only; no execution of receipt, validation, or feasibility judgment workflows occurs within Phase 16

phase_16_to_phase_8_context_recap.context_statement: Phase 16 completes the second major design layer (Phases 8-7 through 16-9) of the generic_block_ai project. Phase 8-7 through 8-10 established human review framework. Phase 9-1 through 9-9 designed safety gates. Phase 10-1 through 10-9 designed implementation pre-gate. Phase 11-1 through 11-9 designed actual reflection & measurement layer. Phase 12-1 through 12-9 designed safe update gate. Phase 13-1 through 13-9 designed input acceptance protocol. Phase 14-1 through 14-9 designed final decision & judgment. Phase 15-1 through 15-9 designed final actual measurement confirmation. Phase 16-1 through 16-9 designed actual measurement input receipt, validation, and feasibility judgment.

phase_16_9_final_statement.statement: Phase 16 実測入力受領・検証層 design is COMPLETE and APPROVED as PASS_DESIGN_ONLY. All 8 design sub-phases (16-1: Receipt, 16-2: Validation, 16-3: Pre-Decision Feasibility, 16-4: Format Validation Rules, 16-5: Evidence Lock Rules, 16-6: Failure Handling Rules, 16-7: Validation Result Report, 16-8: Workflow Execution Feasibility Judgment) have been designed, documented, reviewed, and approved. The design layer is reports-only and contains zero implementation code. NO_GO and NOT_EFFECTIVE states are maintained. Phase 16 is ready for handoff to Phase 15-7 and Phase 15-8 measurement workflows, subject to Phase 16-8 feasibility judgment and Phase 16-3 readiness assessment confirmation.
